chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Ali ibn Yaqteen, who said:

I asked Abu Al-Hasan Musa (peace be upon him) about Mut'ah, so he said: 'And what is it with you and that, for Allah has made you needless from it?' I said, 'I only intended to know it.' So he said: 'It is in the Book of Ali (peace be upon him).' I said, 'We increase it and she increases it?' So he said: 'And what makes it pleasing to him except that?'

key_terms.كِتَابِ عَلِيٍّ: The Book of Ali (referring to the Quran or a specific treatise)
key_terms.نَزِيدُهَا وَ تَزْدَادُ: We increase it (duration) and she increases it (price)

ai.seo_question: What is the source and ruling of Mut'ah according to Imam Musa al-Kazim (peace be upon him)?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam Musa al-Kazim (AS) responds to a query about *Mut'ah* by first noting the questioner's lack of need, then directing him to the 'Book of Ali' (often interpreted as the Quran or a specific written record) as the authoritative source. The concluding phrase, 'Does anything please him except that?', underscores the divine approval and flexibility of the contract, particularly regarding the increase in duration or price. This highlights the Shia view that *Mut'ah* remains a valid, Quranically-sanctioned institution, distinct from permanent marriage, and its regulation is rooted in the teachings of the Ahl al-Bayt.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Ali Bin Yaqteen who said,

‘I asked Abu Al-Hassan Musaasws about the Mut’a, so heasws said: ‘And what is it with you and that, for Allahazwj has Made you to be needless from it?’ I said, ‘But rather, I intended to learn (about) it’. So heasws said: ‘It is in the Book of Aliasws’. So I said, ‘We can increase it, and she can increase it (term)?’ So heasws said: ‘And would it make him feel better except for that?’
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘ Umayr from Afi ibn Yaqtin who has said the following: “

I once asked abu al-Hassan, Musa, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about al-Mut‘ah (advantageous marriage). He (the Imam) said, ‘What do you have to do with it when Allah has made you free of need for it?’ I then said, ‘I only wanted to know about it.’ He (the Imam) said, ‘It is in the book of Ali, ‘Alayhi al-Salam .’ I then asked, ‘Can we extend and they women extend (the time)?’ He (the Imam) said, ‘What else makes him happy?”’
